name: Purpose/product
acceptance_criterion: Repository responsibilities and phase declarations are consistent with shipped scope.
method_and_evidence: Root authority/readme and current Game/Atlas programme state
remaining_limit: Real native G1 and actual Atlas UI acceptance remain open.

name: Architecture
acceptance_criterion: One provider owns each runtime/schema boundary; decisions agree with implementation.
method_and_evidence: META/provider authority and Game PREPARE source versus accepted contract
remaining_limit: Full architecture dependency graph and all current consumers not independently requalified.

name: Implementation
acceptance_criterion: Material implementation invariants survive boundary/error paths.
method_and_evidence: Focused source deltas, exact identity reconciliation and 8 real-Git routing cases
remaining_limit: No blanket all-line runtime review; per-path ledger preserves unverified semantics.

name: Interfaces/contracts
acceptance_criterion: Serialized identity and cross-provider evidence have one versioned authority.
method_and_evidence: Atlas cross-language vectors; META release validator; provider ownership
remaining_limit: META has no actual release manifest and provider evidence is not authenticated by structural validation.

name: Data/persistence
acceptance_criterion: Security state, effect delivery and recovery evidence are atomic and replay safe.
method_and_evidence: Email transaction boundary; Game authority source and candidate handoff
remaining_limit: Full DB concurrency/migration/restore execution not performed.

name: Dependencies/supply chain
acceptance_criterion: Dependency update scope, lockfiles, provenance and advisory results are explicit.
method_and_evidence: All four Dependabot configs and actual toolchain manifests inspected
remaining_limit: No fresh complete CVE/SBOM/secret-history result; update config is not proof of security.

name: Security/privacy
acceptance_criterion: Current credentials, authorization and private-data boundaries fail closed.
method_and_evidence: High-risk source review, scoped negative tests and historical unresolved login hypothesis
remaining_limit: No exhaustive threat-model/control-to-test mapping, penetration test or live admin/privacy audit.

name: Reliability/failure handling
acceptance_criterion: Failures remain bounded, preserve valid state and terminate correctly.
method_and_evidence: 33 Atlas focused regressions and Gateway shutdown/timeouts source
remaining_limit: Injected fixture failures are not current production resilience or chaos evidence.

name: Performance/cost
acceptance_criterion: Latency, cost and capacity changes are demonstrated against a baseline.
method_and_evidence: 77-workflow static census; R5Q measurement boundary
remaining_limit: No current workflow cohort, p50/p95, billing minutes, cache hit, flake/retry or paid agent-token dataset.

name: Tests
acceptance_criterion: Tests reach intended behavior and detect representative violations.
method_and_evidence: 29 Platform tests,37 Game dispatcher tests,33 Atlas tests and scoped META controls
remaining_limit: Green existing tests miss two demonstrated routing cases; full native/E2E/DB matrix not run.

name: Build
acceptance_criterion: Build inputs, toolchain, dependency identity and artifact outputs are reproducible.
method_and_evidence: Composer/Cargo/Go/Playwright manifests and image workflow inspected
remaining_limit: No full fresh build; PHP8.4 sandbox does not satisfy Platform PHP8.5; native Rust absent.

name: CI/verification
acceptance_criterion: One required aggregate proves all selected profiles for exact PR/MQ candidate.
method_and_evidence: Complete static workflow census plus direct Platform gate/trigger review and routing reproduction
remaining_limit: Static YAML census does not qualify every conditional branch or matrix permutation.

name: Release/deploy
acceptance_criterion: Published and deployed artifact identity is bound to accepted candidate and recovery proof.
method_and_evidence: Synology workflow dependency review; historical release recovery record
remaining_limit: No current release deployment, rollback or actual environment approval readback.

name: Configuration/infrastructure
acceptance_criterion: Actual infrastructure and privileged configuration match approved source.
method_and_evidence: Available GitHub source and historical recovery records only
remaining_limit: No host access, environment-secret values, current admin-only org state or runtime configuration inventory.

name: Operations/observability
acceptance_criterion: Critical journeys have observable failure/restore evidence and accountable recovery.
method_and_evidence: Issue59 gap register and archived transfer evidence
remaining_limit: Live telemetry, SLOs, incident response and alert delivery were not exercised.

name: Documentation
acceptance_criterion: Instructions describe actual setup, current authority and honest capability.
method_and_evidence: Current README/bootstrap and historical audit lineage compared
remaining_limit: Not every documentation link or operative-looking open PR independently reconciled.

name: Instructions/skills/prompts
acceptance_criterion: One rule has one authority, loaded selectively without broadening permission.
method_and_evidence: v3 policy/routing, provider bindings and R5Q limitations
remaining_limit: Binding/configuration is not actual instruction delivery or measured efficiency.

name: Developer/agent ergonomics
acceptance_criterion: Clean setup, recovery and selective execution are usable in actual supported clients.
method_and_evidence: Local Python/Node tests, platform setup inspection and routing validation
remaining_limit: No full clean developer installation or actual client delivery benchmark.

name: Repository governance
acceptance_criterion: Protected exact-candidate integration is not replaced by candidate-controlled assertions.
method_and_evidence: Read-only authority preflight, current source gate and WP1 recorded protected closeout
remaining_limit: No complete live admin settings attestation; audit run and meta-gate cannot certify report truth.

name: Current work/drift
acceptance_criterion: Source, candidate, historical closure and active ownership are kept distinct.
method_and_evidence: 76-identifier reconciliation; unresolved Game coordinate correction; provider Issue/PR readback
remaining_limit: Mutable source-of-truth issues may advance after observation; some old PR/ref statuses need fresh reads.

name: Portability
acceptance_criterion: Supported runtime/OS combinations satisfy their actual required contracts.
method_and_evidence: Linux Python/Node execution and current toolchain requirements
remaining_limit: No current Windows/GPU/native or supported complete OS/runtime matrix.

name: Product/UI
acceptance_criterion: Actual core user journeys meet functional, responsive, visual and accessibility criteria.
method_and_evidence: Atlas343/344 explicitly records outstanding runtime acceptance; repository phase definitions
remaining_limit: No current initialized-world visual review, full browser journey or independent accessibility audit.

name: Simplification/technical debt
acceptance_criterion: Changes remove duplicate authority/evidence while preserving minimum useful verification.
method_and_evidence: Finite existing programmes, risk register, stable aggregates and temporary collector retirement
remaining_limit: No quantified cost benefit claimed; no organization-wide redesign is justified by the scoped evidence alone.
